value.rationale: The motivating paper raises a genuine dimensional obstruction: in complex dimension two a q-range need not contain the origin. This theorem completely determines the q-ranges of all planar scaled antiunitaries from just norm and ordinary numerical radius, including independent, differently ordered hole-closing and maximal-radius thresholds. It is a natural structural classification, not a sample counterexample or a renamed textbook bound.
